source.brief: Create an 8-slide executive-profile deck for a newly appointed nonprofit chief executive. The attachment contains approved biography facts. Use Web Research only to verify current public appointments and recent official statements; use Image Research for licensed official portraits and documentary images of the organizations mentioned. Do not include private family information or infer political views.
